rationale: js-transform-type.spec.js already thoroughly covers the VRL/JS toggle selection behavior, edition-gated visibility, org-switching, and function creation flows. The page objects (functionsPage.js, functionsFormValidationPage.js) were updated in the same PR to target the new OToggleGroupItem selectors and data-state='on' assertions, so the existing tests continue to exercise the core behavioral paths through the new toggle UI. The delta is the NEW visual elements (language badges, separator divider, per-option info tooltips) — these are not asserted by any existing test. Append new test() blocks for these visual elements to js-transform-type.spec.js to avoid sprawl. The FunctionsToolbar form validation spec already covers the VRL-default-selection check and cancel navigation; no changes needed there.
